content:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout for `release v4.0.1` -> embed-route canary 5% -> change window 45m. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/staged-rollout :rocket:
jamie (oncall): tagging team. i'll watch p99 and 5xx. can someone pre-pin fallback variant? want quick revert path. :mag:
stefan (runtime): pinned fallback `embed-cpu@2026-02-20` on route: `rdwctl pin fallback embed-route --variant embed-cpu@2026-02-20`
aya (releases): noted. scheduled ramp to 20% at +12m if healthy. release notes link will include canary ID.
slo-bot: INFO: Baseline p99 for embed-route (prod) = 820ms. alert thresholds set at p99 >= 1s for warn, >= 1.5s for critical.
jamie (oncall): initial 5m snapshot looks fine. starting synthetic 200 reqs/min against canary group.
infra-bot: metric: gpu_utilization@host-g01 jumped from 62% -> 91% in 2m on canary hosts.
stefan (runtime): noticing p99 for POST /v1/embeddings on canary -> 1.12s. p50 unchanged. p95 ~ 600ms.
jamie (oncall): slo-bot, got a p99 warn?
slo-bot: ALERT: ml_inference_latency_p99 (embed-route canary) crossed warning threshold. current=1120ms | window=5m | triggered_at=5961230120
aya (releases): should we hold the ramp to 20%?
stefan (runtime): recommend hold. symptoms: GPU kernel hot path heavier with new quantized ops; memory throttling causing kernel preemption. not necessarily 5xx but tail latency impact.
jamie (oncall): pausing traffic shift. running `deploy-bot hold-rollout 5961230000`
deploy-bot: rollout for 5961230000 placed on HOLD by jamie. reason: p99 warn.
jamie (oncall): also adding APM traces to canary: `rdwctl traces enable --route embed-route --sample 50`
stefan (runtime): correlating traces: long GC stalls inside CUDA memory manager on host-g01: logs show repeated cudaMalloc retries.
infra-bot: event: scheduled maintenance (kernel-update) was in progress on host-g03 but shouldn't affect canary. unrelated.
jamie (oncall): decision options: 1) revert to pinned cpu variant (fast fallback, higher token cost) 2) patch runtime to disable new kernel path and restart canary workers 3) keep hold and investigate deeper. preferences?
aya (releases): product asked to minimize customer visible cost. prefer runtime patch + restart if quick.
stefan (runtime): can push hotfix toggle `--disable-quant-kernel` to canary in ~9m and restart workers. less risky than full rollback.
jamie (oncall): ok do runtime toggle. stefan, please also add per-host traffic exclusion for host-g01 if utilization stays >90%. command: `rdwctl route update --exclude-host host-g01 --route embed-route`
stefan (runtime): applying toggle to canary: `rdw infra set runtime.quantopt.enabled=false --scope canary`
slo-bot: NOTE: automated rollback rule: if p99 >= 1.5s OR 5xx >= 2% for 5m, auto-rollback will trigger.
infra-bot: host-g01 show OOM events from cuda driver at 5961230085. logs: `[5961230085] cuda: out of device memory while allocating 1.2GB`
jamie (oncall): excluding host-g01 from canary as precaution.
stefan (runtime): `rdwctl route update --exclude-host host-g01 --route embed-route` executed.
aya (releases): adding incident INF-5071 to track and noting hold in release dashboard.
jamie (oncall): timeline: hold at 5961230125, runtime toggle ETA 9m, restart + 10m observe, decision point ~5961230700.
stefan (runtime): applying toggle now and restarting canary workers: `rdw infra restart --group embed-canary --grace 30s`
deploy-bot: infra restart command accepted. jobs queued.
slo-bot: METRIC: p99 trending down to 900ms after restarts. current p99=890ms | p95=560ms | 5xx=0.1%
jamie (oncall): good sign. keep hold until p99 < 1s for 15m.
stefan (runtime): agree. also capturing extra traces for 15m: `rdwctl traces enable --route embed-route --duration 15m`
aya (releases): will hold the ramp and update product/ops slack channel.
infra-bot: host-g01 remains excluded and will be reprovisioned for CUDA driver patch after investigation.
slo-bot: UPDATE: p99 stable at ~880ms for 7m. no 5xx increase. auto-rollback still armed.
jamie (oncall): after 15m stable, we'll resume to 20% in 5% steps every 2m and watch p99. mark resume with `deploy-bot resume-rollout 5961230000`
stefan (runtime): once resumed, recommend temporary elevated trace sampling for the first 30m.
aya (releases): documented the hold and mitigation actions in the release notes. INF-5071 link: https://redwood.internal/infra/INF-5071
jamie (oncall): thanks all. keeping thread open until resume. :white_check_mark:
-- end of thread --
